cases.goal: Investigate why the UART receiver timed out and identify evidence in the available design notes.

files.uart_clock.md: UART receive sampling uses a sixteen-times oversampling clock. The receiver timeout counter halts when reset is asserted.
files.uart_trace.md: At tick 128 the reset remained asserted, so the UART receive timeout did not advance until tick 180.
files.unrelated.md: The GPIO pins use ordinary pull-up resistors and have no effect on UART receiver timeout.

cases.goal: Investigate conflicting statements about whether a reset disables the watchdog, and report uncertainty.

files.watchdog_a.md: Revision A states watchdog remains active during system reset. This statement refers to an older gate implementation.
files.watchdog_b.md: Revision B states watchdog is disabled while system reset is asserted. The revision was introduced after A.
